title: The ALPINE-ALMA [CII] survey: The population of [CII]-undetected galaxies and their role in the L<SUB>[CII]</SUB>-SFR relation
question: What are the average [CII] properties of the [CII]-undetected galaxies in the ALPINE survey at z ~ 5, and what is their role in the L_[CII]-SFR relation?

what.value: ALMA DR1 continuum-subtracted data-cubes, [CII] detections and 3sigma upper limits

evidence.quote: In particular, we extract each spectrum from the original data-cubes of the ALPINE data release 1 (DR1; (cite: Bethermin20))
The errors on the [CII] luminosities are taken from (cite: Bethermin20) for the ALPINE detections

what.value: Stellar masses and SED-fitted SFRs, multi-wavelength data and UV magnitudes

evidence.quote: The stellar masses and SFRs are those from the SED-fitting (cite: Faisst20).

what.value: Observed velocity offset distribution between Ly-alpha and [CII] (Delta v_Lya)

evidence.quote: we apply to each source a spectral offset randomly extracted from the $\Delta v_{\mathrm{Ly}\alpha}$ distribution obtained by (cite: Cassata20) from a sub-sample of the ALPINE detections

what.value: IRX-beta relation predictions for SFR(IR) of continuum-undetected galaxies

evidence.quote: It is worth to specify that none of our 34 [CII] non-detections is detected in continuum. Therefore, the SFR(IR) for all of these galaxies comes from the IRX-$\beta$ relation by (cite: Fudamoto20).

what.value: Optical galaxy coordinates from COSMOS2015 and 3D-HST catalogs

evidence.quote: The coordinates of each galaxy are taken either from the COSMOS2015 (cite: Laigle16) or 3D-HST (cite: Brammer12; Skelton14) catalogs

what.value: L_[CII]-SFR relations from literature for comparison

evidence.quote: summarizes the parameters describing the L$_\mathrm{[CII]}$-SFR relations found in the literature and in this work.

recipe.goal: Select sample of [CII] non-detections with robust UV spectroscopic redshifts
recipe.method: Visually inspect optical/UV spectra of the 43 ALPINE [CII] non-detections to select sources with multiple high S/N spectral features and prominent Ly-alpha emission, excluding 9 sources with weak/no Ly-alpha and noisy spectra.
assumptions: Redshift obtained from the peak of the Ly-alpha line can be corrected using the observed velocity offset distribution between Ly-alpha and [CII]

recipe.goal: Extract 1D ALMA spectra and perform Monte Carlo mean spectral stacking
recipe.method: Extract 1D spectra from ALPINE DR1 continuum-subtracted data-cubes in a 1'' radius aperture centered at optical positions over ~3 GHz around the Ly-alpha expected frequency. Align to Ly-alpha redshift, apply random velocity offsets drawn from the Cassata et al. (2020) Delta v_Lya distribution, compute mean stack, fit a Gaussian to check FWHM <= 400 km s^-1 until 1000 realizations are collected, and average the realizations weighted by S/N.
key_parameters: FWHM <= 400 km s^-1 filter for 1000 realizations
S/N weight w = S/N, with noise measured at |v| > 600 km s^-1 from peak
assumptions: 0 < Delta v_Lya < 400 km s^-1 distribution from ALPINE detections applies to non-detections

recipe.goal: Measure velocity-integrated flux, [CII] luminosity, and uncertainties, and repeat in SFR bins
recipe.method: Integrate the Gaussian-fitted stacked line to get velocity-integrated flux, convert to L_[CII] using Solomon et al. (1992) equation at z_med = 5.52, and estimate uncertainty via delete-d jackknife resampling (500 realizations removing 20% of the 34 spectra). Repeat stacking by splitting the 34 sources into two bins of 17 sources each at median log(SFR_TOT) = 1.16.
key_parameters: 500 jackknife realizations removing 20% of spectra; 16th and 84th percentiles for error
2 SFR bins of 17 objects each divided at log(SFR_TOT,med / M_sun yr^-1) = 1.16
assumptions: Lambda-CDM cosmology with H_0 = 70 km s^-1 Mpc^-1, Omega_m = 0.3, Omega_Lambda = 0.7; Chabrier (2003) IMF

recipe.method: Combine the stacked [CII] luminosity and mean total SFR of the non-detections with the individual ALPINE [CII] detections, and fit log(L_[CII]/L_sun) = a + b * log(SFR/M_sun yr^-1) using the Bayesian linear regression package linmix.
key_parameters: Average uncertainty on total SFR ~ 0.2 dex
assumptions: SFR_TOT = SFR(UV) + SFR(IR), where SFR(IR) for continuum-undetected galaxies comes from the IRX-beta relation of Fudamoto et al. (2020); Chabrier IMF (De Looze et al. 2014 relation scaled by dividing SFR by 1.06)
